DivinecraftFireEmber.description: Counts direct hits since the last Solid Foundation. Five hits consume the count and grant Solid Foundation, which is re-granted at most once every 10 seconds.

DivinecraftSolidFoundation.name: Divinecraft - Fire Solid Foundation
DivinecraftSolidFoundation.description: The next direct hit unleashes Solid Foundation. Re-granted at most once every 10 seconds.

Disintegration.description: Increase physical penetraion by 5 and critical damage by 5% per stack.
